title: EXCLUDE BRAINORDINATES FROM A CIFTI FILE
description: Writes a modified version of <cifti-in>, where all brainordinates outside the specified roi(s) are removed from the file.  The direction can be either an integer starting from 1, or the strings 'ROW' or 'COLUMN'.  If -cifti-roi is specified, no other -*-roi option may be specified.  If not using -cifti-roi, any -*-roi options not present will discard the relevant structure, if present in the input file.

direction.description: which dimension to change the mapping on (integer, 'ROW', or 'COLUMN')

left_roi.description: vertices to use from left hemisphere

right_roi.description: vertices to use from right hemisphere
